borrow_source.from: Schwab marketdata quotes reference: isShortable, isHardToBorrow, htbRate (read as rebate; cost = Fed funds - htbRate), floor = short_borrow_cost_annual_pct; 360-day accrual
borrow_source.to: Schwab marketdata quotes reference, snapshotted daily for every open short: isShortable, isHardToBorrow, htbRate. Per Schwab (2026-09-23) htbRate is the annualized hard-to-borrow fee, 0 when easy to borrow, charged as end-of-day short market value x rate / 360. Charged rate = max(|htbRate|, short_borrow_cost_annual_pct); hard-to-borrow with no rate quoted = short_borrow_hard_to_borrow_pct.

breach_policy.from: Instruction is REFUSED at log time, not silently clipped. A breach must be an explicit config change in the chain.
breach_policy.to: An instruction that breaks a rule in force at its fill is refused at the fill and listed with the reason in the published record; it is never clipped to fit. Logging itself is refused if market cap (FMP) or, for SHORT, Schwab borrow terms cannot be fetched, or if the machine clock is more than 120s off the server clock.

cash_yield.from: Fed funds (prior month, FMP) minus cash_spread_bps on positive cash, including short-sale proceeds
cash_yield.to: Positive cash, including short-sale proceeds, earns Fed funds (prior month, FMP) plus cash_spread_bps (currently -25, i.e. Fed funds minus 0.25%). Negative cash pays Fed funds plus margin_spread_bps.

universe_constraint.from: No micro caps. Hard floor: $2bn market cap AND $25mm 20-day median dollar ADV at instruction date.
universe_constraint.to: No micro caps. Adding to or opening a position requires market cap >= $2bn at the moment of logging (FMP) and 20-session median dollar volume >= $25mm over the sessions before the fill date.

unused_fields_note.to: margin_rate_annual_pct and cash_yield_annual_pct apply only if rates_floating is false; rates_floating is true.
